cases.setup: mkdir -p d/sub/deep d/empty d/.hid d/sub/more/inner; printf hello > d/a.txt; printf x > d/sub/b.txt; head -c 1000 /dev/zero > d/sub/deep/big.bin; : > d/.hid/note; printf 'twelve bytes' > d/sub/more/a.txt; : > d/zero

cases.name: a tie: the smaller path wins
cases.setup: mkdir -p d/b d/a; printf 12345 > d/b/x; printf 12345 > d/a/z; printf 1 > d/c

cases.name: in the top directory
cases.setup: mkdir -p d/s; printf 123456789 > d/top; printf 12 > d/s/f

cases.name: a hidden file
cases.setup: mkdir d; printf 123 > d/.big; printf 1 > d/small

cases.name: a big file
cases.setup: mkdir -p d/x; head -c 5000000 /dev/zero > d/x/big; head -c 4999999 /dev/zero > d/other

cases.name: directories alone: no files
cases.stdout:
biggest: no files in d
rc=1

cases.name: missing directory
cases.stdout:
biggest: nope: No such file or directory
rc=1
